zh: 银发〔2016〕261号规定，转账到账方式可由客户选择：实时到账、普通到账（2小时）或次日到账（24小时）。在到账前，客户可以撤销转账。AnBan 默认使用2小时到账，可在设置中改为24小时。
en: Under PBOC notice Yinfa [2016] No. 261, customers choose real-time arrival, normal arrival (2 hours) or next-day arrival (24 hours) for transfers. A held transfer can be cancelled before it arrives. AnBan defaults to 2 hours; Settings can switch to 24 hours.

zh: 钱一旦到账，银行无法撤销，也不能冻结收款人账户或透露收款人信息。银行可以请收款银行协助，向收款人提出自愿退回的请求。如对方拒绝，客户可依民法典第122条以不当得利起诉。若遭遇诈骗，应立即拨打96110或110，并保留凭证。
en: Once money has arrived, the bank cannot reverse it, freeze the payee's account or reveal the payee. The bank can ask the receiving bank to request a voluntary return. If that is refused, the customer can sue for unjust enrichment under Civil Code article 122. If scammed, call 96110 or 110 at once and keep receipts.

zh: 同一存款人在同一家银行的存款，本金加利息最高保障人民币50万元（¥500,000）。
en: Deposits are protected up to ¥500,000 per depositor per bank, including principal and interest.

zh: 每人每年凭身份证件可购汇等值5万美元。购汇须申报用途。不得用于境外买房、证券投资、人寿保险或投资性保险。借用亲属额度分拆购汇属于违规行为。
en: Each person may buy foreign exchange up to the equivalent of US$50,000 per year with ID. A purpose must be declared. It cannot be used for overseas property, securities, life insurance or investment-type insurance. Splitting a purchase across relatives' quotas is a violation.

zh: 银行应在15天内处理投诉，复杂案件可延长至30天。如对处理结果不满意，可拨打监管机构消费者热线12378。
en: Banks must handle a complaint within 15 days; complex cases may be extended to 30 days. If you are unhappy with the result, call the regulator's consumer hotline 12378.
source: 《银行业保险业消费投诉处理管理办法》

zh: 警察、法院和银行工作人员不会要求你把钱转到“安全账户”。不要向任何人透露短信验证码。全国反诈热线是96110。
en: Police, courts and bank staff never ask you to move money to a "safe account". Never share SMS codes. The national anti-fraud hotline is 96110.

zh: 个人大额存单的起存金额为20万元。定期存款提前支取，通常按活期存款利率计算已存期间的利息。
en: Large-denomination certificates of deposit (大额存单) for individuals start at ¥200,000. Withdrawing a term deposit early usually pays only the demand-deposit rate for the time held.
source: PBOC 《大额存单管理暂行办法》

zh: 风险问卷把产品评为R1至R5，把客户评为C1至C5。Cn级客户只能购买R1至Rn级产品。风险评估有效期为1年，到期后必须重新测评。问卷必须由客户本人作答。
en: Products are rated R1–R5 and customers C1–C5 by a risk questionnaire. A Cn customer may buy only R1 to Rn products. The assessment is valid for 1 year and must be retaken after that. The customer must answer it themselves.
source: 《商业银行理财业务监督管理办法》 suitability rules

zh: 个人养老金每年缴费最高12,000元，可以在税前扣除。领取时按3%的税率缴税。
en: Personal pension (个人养老金) contributions up to ¥12,000 per year are tax-deductible. Withdrawals are taxed at 3%.

zh: II类账户向非绑定账户转账或收款，每日限额10,000元，每年限额200,000元。
en: Class II accounts can pay to or receive from non-linked accounts up to ¥10,000 per day and ¥200,000 per year.

zh: 分期手续费按原始本金收取，会使实际年化利率约为名义利率的2倍。自2022年起，银行必须在客户同意前展示年化利率。
en: Instalment fees charged on the original principal make the real annual rate about twice the nominal one. Since 2022 banks must show the annualised rate before you agree.
source: 2022 银保监会 信用卡业务通知

zh: 如果非柜面支付受到限制，常见原因是身份证件过期、交易异常或账户长期未使用。请携带身份证到网点核实并解除限制。
en: If online or non-counter payments are restricted (非柜面限制), common reasons are an expired ID, unusual activity or a dormant account. Bring your ID to a branch to have it reviewed and lifted.
